description: Free. Start here. Searches components by part number or keyword (e.g. 'STM32F103', 'buck converter 3A') across JLCPCB, Mouser and DigiKey in parallel. Results are merged by MPN with indicative price and stock per source and a datasheet_status. For an MPN query, eval boards and dev kits come back separately as related_kits. Parts in your organisation's private library whose MPN, manufacturer, description, type, category or tag matches are appended with source='private_library' and their tags. For spec-based discovery in plain language, use search_datasheets. datasheet_status: 'ready' → read it; 'extracting' / 'queued' / 'pending' / 'resolving' → poll check_extraction_status; 'not_extracted' → prefetch_datasheets; 'no_source' / 'unsupported' → request_datasheet_upload. Full list in the server instructions.

limit.description: Max results per provider (default 20). With providers='all' the total can be up to 3× this.
